description: Figure 3(b) is a placeholder panel intended to display BLEU scores for GPT-NEO 1.3B trained on the target dataset $D_t$, as described in Section 4. The panel is currently blank, rendered as a solid light gray rectangle with no axes, labels, data lines, or annotations. It is positioned to the right of Figure 3(a), which shows the corresponding loss curves. The caption indicates that this plot should illustrate BLEU score trends over training for three sample groups — regular members, members with near-duplicates, and held-out data — but no such data is visually represented in the current image.
